parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: Specify the token that is used to display the returned tags on multiple pages.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region in which the resource is located.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Set the value to INSTANCE.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun drds list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type INSTANCE --next-token 6ab4640a-479b-41d0-ad3c-c6e888bc3d8f --tag Value=red Key=color --resource-id dm-hbgau1zp0000 --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun drds ListTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'dm-hbgau1zp0000' --Tag.1.Key color --NextToken '6ab4640a-479b-41d0-ad3c-c6e888bc3d8f' --Tag.1.Value red --ResourceType INSTANCE --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
